releases.notes:
# 1.5

![menu_i-editor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c00175c10e3fd5e6ae07a3d886a169d38f24e544.png)

This version is mostly technical in nature: there are few innovations, but at the same time, many technical changes have been implemented that have improved the editor's work in many aspects.

**A new component has been added:**
- Bees: allows you to communicate with entities in the bee hive
- Dye: gives the object the properties of a dye

**Changes:**
- Added mini icons on the buttons. They may be missing in some places because no suitable icon was found for it.
![components_icons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b29abe3ed417fd2a94c2e0c402396eb5a517581.png)

- Added text colors for some entity variants
![entity_variants_text_color](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ccb3cd0e76060b7b3b685c5d2e99d0b4f62b2013.png)

- Added types of name and description for the item: Default (Regular), Atlas, Score and Translate.
	- Splitting the name and description into types opens up additional possibilities for editing text and makes working with it more flexible.
![type_text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d7ad5beb9fc92ba3f2ebd65e3c3e0625cbb82fb_0.webp)

- All editing elements have been fully translated into Russian, Ukrainian and Belarusian
- The structure of the file contents in the components section has been changed
- Fixed some bugs with the key for translating component descriptions
- Fixed an error when changing the name of an item, the text was merged

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SayNooty/I-Editor/compare/update-1.1.0...update-1.5

releases.notes:
**New customization options for the item:**
- Component (Each component has its own parameter editing window)
- Damage
- Firework
- Trim

**Changes:**
- Added the ability to open the I Editor menu by pressing the "quick action" button
- The "Set Book Cover" editing window has been changed. Instead of a slider, there is now a switch that shows which type of book can be displayed.
- The "Set Banner Pattern" editing window has been changed. First, you need to select the desired flag pattern, similar to the selection of enchantment or attribute in other editing windows. After selecting a pattern, the player can customize the application of the pattern at their discretion.
- The "Set Potion" editing window has been changed. Instead of the switch, you now need to click on the check mark that affects the activation of this parameter.
- Changed the editing of the maximum stack of items 64 > 99

readmeSummary: I Editor (Item Editor) is not just a datapack, it's a true breakthrough in the possibilities of item editing! 🛠️ Forget the boring limitations of vanilla Minecraft.
